thread:
maria: repro: read-after-write flake during prefix handoff when eviction overlaps commit. small log attached.
infra-bot: alert kvcache error spike node-7
ben: repro steps?
maria: append-heavy -> demote -> immediate read loop. ~50% repro. reader saw prior version id.
alex: guess: handoff token moved but commit not compacted before eviction/tombstone cleanup.
leo: options: pin while commit finishes; two-phase handoff; or emit short-lived grace marker so reads consult previous owner for a window.
sara: pinning risks leaked memory on stalled writers. two-phase is heavier. grace marker lightweight but needs TTL.
ben: grace sketch: on demote emit grace(prefix, ttl=200ms). read checks grace -> forward to prevOwner.
jing: forwarding adds tail latency.
alex: alternative fast-path: store tiny commit checksum in prefix metadata. read validates checksum; if mismatch then fallback to forward. cheap common path; fallback preserves correctness.
maria: local perf: meta-validate +0.5ms, forward +1.7ms. CAS contention spikes at high qps in bench.
ben: pragmatic: implement metadata fast-path + grace-forward fallback. TTL and CAS tuning required.
sara: will draft RFC with diagrams, pseudocode, metrics to monitor and rollout plan.
ben: I'll add e2e test: concurrent append+demote+read across nodes with GC-delay knob.
leo: I'll add feature flag and a smoke job for rollout.
jing: I'll run perf at representative qps to tune CAS/TTL.
maria: action owners noted. thanks all.
